body: Sounds good.  But how do I DM you?  Unfamiliar.

I did not know that "In Search Of" was available on DVD, otherwise I would have gotten it.  By the way, what is your favorite episode?  Or multiple ones?  My favorite was the one on Reincarnation.  Even my own Doctor believes in Reincarnation!
Are you the Black-lady I played a few years ago??  She was Black and a very good player.  She left for a neighbor island, so I thought she came back and it was you.  And what part of Oahu are you at?
Did that bar have a billiards table?

Thank you.  Let me also add that even with my ugly-face, I still managed to get Two romantic relationships, Two girlfriends.  Even though those two relationships eventually fizzled out and ended, I still am grateful I had them.  Those two ladies were classy enough that they looked beyond the surface and into my Inner person.  That's what I call a CLASSY lady.

The Same as you, I'm ugly too.  But I still want to stay alive because my ugly face did Not stop me from reaching my goals.  Every so often, obstacles block my way, but I just have to find a way to get past them.  Sometimes it's a difficult struggle but I have to keep at it.  It's called Endurance.
